scope: R1 (reasoning slot) transport-level missing positions only

positions.outcome: transport timeout (~600s), no scorable answer, status=failed, quality=null
transport timeout (~600s), no scorable answer, status=failed, quality=null

trigger.basis: transport failure only; generation parameters were never adjusted based on answer content
trigger.note: these positions are model-output timeouts, not wrong answers; recording them as 0 would contaminate labels

rule.eligibility: any R1 position whose first two transport attempts both produced no scorable answer
rule.on_third_failure: position remains missing (quality=null); NEVER scored as 0

timing_statement.concurrent_with_main_collection: rescue writes to raw/reasoning_RESCUE.jsonl and raw/reasoning_ATTEMPTS_RESCUE.jsonl (attempt=3, amendment-referenced); merged into raw/reasoning.jsonl only after the main collector terminates, replacing the quality=null rows for the same keys

stop_condition: if rescue-eligible positions exceed a few percent of R1 positions, collection pauses and service health is re-evaluated instead of patching toward a superficially complete panel
